hypothesis: Deeper neural networks can learn more complex features and improve image classification performance
prediction: A deep neural network with 5+ layers, trained on ImageNet with ReLU activation and dropout, will achieve an error rate lower than 20%
measurement_method: Evaluate the model on the ImageNet validation set
falsification_condition: If the error rate of the deep neural network is not significantly lower than 26% (e.g., p-value > 0.05 in a paired t-test), or if the model fails to converge due to vanishing gradients or overfitting
